methods.description: Multiply the amount used once by the number of repetitions.
Multiply the whole quantity by the given fraction.
Multiply the whole quantity by its decimal proportion.
Find how many equal pieces fit by dividing quantity by piece size, using reciprocals for fractions or equivalent whole-number decimal division.
Calculate the first amount and remainder before applying a later fraction or fitting more items.
Convert mixed fraction and decimal quantities into a consistent form to subtract or share.
